sourceNote: Foundation remains an original Japanese draft progression. Core 1–30 follows the existing English Construction Foreman lesson objectives in src/data/construction-foreman-lesson-content.ts; Japanese language progression and trade terminology require independent review. Topic map only; no app, audio or production availability is implied.
foundation: Greet a crew member politely and say your name and role
Identify people on site without assuming their role
Point to a tool or material and confirm its name
Count people and common items with the right counters
Ask where a worker or object is
Distinguish a place from an action taking place there
Ask a short yes/no question and correct a mistaken item
State a simple schedule and meeting place
Ask for repetition and check what you heard
Review a short morning check-in and hand off to Core
core: Greet the crew and ask one worker to confirm their role.
Name a concern from the safety briefing and ask where to find the site plan.
Name a tool and ask a crew member to bring it.
Request a material and confirm its quantity and unit from the order.
Point out a location on the plan and ask which revision and measurement apply.
Ask for a framing instruction to be repeated and confirm the referenced part.
Identify one roof material and ask where its approved installation instructions are.
Ask which concrete delivery and foundation check are confirmed, and which are pending.
Acknowledge a reported problem and ask where it occurred.
Read back a measurement with its unit and ask for confirmation.
Explain a schedule change and ask the crew to confirm the revised time.
Report an electrical concern, identify the location and ask the authorized person to confirm next steps.
Describe the specified drywall finish and ask which detail needs confirmation.
Describe an observed mismatch, refer to the specification and agree on who will review it.
Ask a new worker about experience and availability, then confirm where first-day orientation happens.
Explain a dependency between two crews and confirm the responsible contact and revised handoff.
Report a delivery shortage, read back the order details and agree on a follow-up contact.
Summarize inspection preparation, distinguish pending checks from approval and confirm who will respond.
Practice requesting emergency help with the site location and known observations, without inventing treatment advice.
Summarize two closeout items, assign a follow-up contact and distinguish completion from verification.
Guide a client through completed and pending work, invite questions and confirm who will follow up.
Explain the invoice details you can confirm, ask about an unclear amount and identify the billing contact.
Explain a weather-related change, distinguish a proposed date from a confirmed one and request acknowledgement.
Describe a quality observation, cite the current reference and arrange a documented review instead of prescribing an unverified fix.
Explain a supervised practice task, invite clarification and ask the new worker to repeat the understood sequence.
Explain team expectations, invite a concern and confirm how it will be passed to the appropriate contact.
Summarize completed and pending work, confirm the crew check-in and state tomorrow's plan and open questions.
Summarize both accounts of a disagreement neutrally, confirm what is agreed and refer unresolved concerns appropriately.
Give a realistic team briefing that explains the challenge, invites concerns and identifies support and follow-up.
Run a crew briefing that confirms attendance, the site-plan contact, task handoffs and questions, then summarize what remains unconfirmed.
master: Lead a full morning briefing with late arrivals
Coordinate two trades sharing one work area
Resolve a tool shortage without changing the plan silently
Clarify a drawing discrepancy and record the answer
Check a delivery against an order and report a mismatch
Discuss an unexpected delay and a proposed recovery time
Respond to a safety concern by stopping and escalating
Explain a schedule change to another supervisor
Relay a client question without promising an unapproved answer
Prepare for an inspection and separate evidence from approval
Guide a new worker through a site orientation
Hand off an unfinished task to the next shift
Reconcile different accounts of what was completed
Ask a specialist to clarify a technical term
Explain a weather-related pause and restart condition
Give a location and observations in an emergency rehearsal
Review a punch list and assign follow-up contacts
Walk a client through confirmed and pending work
Summarize a change request with its decision still open
Lead a final briefing, questions, status, and closeout
